title: Stream backpressure and retry contract + idempotency scoping clarification
author: Maya Patel
description:
Motivation: Streaming endpoints have historically blurred the line between per-request transient failures (prompted retries) and stream-level terminal failures, which causes inconsistent signals to client SDKs and downstream tools. This PR standardizes backpressure/retry semantics for streaming responses, clarifies how Retry-After is interpreted for streaming chunks versus request-level responses, and defines how idempotency keys should be scoped when clients attempt automatic replay of interrupted streams (especially when function/tool calling is enabled).

Summary of changes: - Introduce a stream-level error classification in the OpenAI compatibility adapter: transient_chunk, terminal_chunk, and request-level. Transient_chunk errors (e.g. temporary 503 due to autoscaler pressure) can include a Retry-After header and should be surfaced to the client SDKs as retriable pieces, whereas terminal_chunk errors (e.g. model OOM or invalid payload) should abort the stream and surface a structured OpenAI-style error. - Define Retry-After handling rules: prefer Retry-After-seconds when present; accept HTTP-date fallback; cap interpreted delay to a configurable max (default 120s) to avoid long blocking in streaming reconnection flows. - Add new header semantics: X-RW-Idempotency-Scope: "call"|"stream" that documents whether the supplied Idempotency-Key applies to a single function/tool invocation (call) or the logical streaming session (stream). Default is "call" to preserve existing behavior; operators may opt-in to "stream" when they know replay semantics are safe for multi-chunk outputs. - Adapter behavior: when mapping backend rate-limit/503/429 responses to OpenAI-compatible errors, include an "error.type" field using our standardized taxonomy (rate_limit, server_error.transient, server_error.terminal, invalid_request) and include "retry_after" normalized to seconds when present. - SDK contract note: Recommend SDKs attempt exponential backoff with jitter when encountering transient_chunk events and attempt to resume the stream only when the adapter returns a retry_after <= 30s by default. The SDKs may surface a resumable stream object to callers.

Checklist: - [x] Spec doc for stream error classification and header semantics (docs/compat/streaming-retry.md) - [x] Runtime changes to classify chunk errors and emit normalized headers - [x] Adapter translation to OpenAI error schema and added tests - [x] Python/TS SDK compatibility notes and example snippets - [x] E2E test that simulates autoscaler pressure and verifies Retry-After propagation

Compatibility notes: This preserves existing default idempotency behavior (key scoped to individual calls) to avoid surprising existing clients. The opt-in X-RW-Idempotency-Scope header allows integrators to explicitly request stream-scoped idempotency, which is required for some tool-calling replay strategies. Expect telemetry metrics (stream_resume_attempts, stream_transient_failures) to increase during rollout while downstream SDKs adopt the resumable-stream object.

Rollout plan: Feature-flagged behind compat.stream_retries. Enable in canary for 1 week, monitor stream_resume_attempts and user-facing error rates. If stable, progressively enable for all OpenAI-compat endpoints.

References: Linear ENG-1927 for design, SUP-881 support ticket for a customer incident that motivated the clarified Retry-After behavior.
commits_summary: 6 commits: spec(stream-retries): add docs and diagrams; runtime: classify chunk errors and emit normalized retry headers; adapter: translate backend 429/503 to structured OpenAI-style errors; sdk-notes: add Python and TS snippets; tests: add unit + e2e autoscaler pressure simulation; docs: link rollout plan and metrics
changed_files: High-level file changes: - adapter/openai_compat/streaming_adapter.py (core translation logic, ~220 loc added) - runtime/streaming/error_classifier.py (new component to classify transient vs terminal chunk errors) - runtime/streaming/retry_policy.py (parsing Retry-After, capping, and backoff helpers) - docs/compat/streaming-retry.md (spec + operator notes) - sdk/python/examples/resumable_stream_example.py (illustrative example) - tests/e2e/test_stream_retry_after.py (e2e autoscaler pressure test) - tests/unit/test_error_classification.py - CHANGELOG.md (compatibility notes)
review_comments:
Alex Kim: Please add a metric to distinguish transient_chunk vs terminal_chunk; without that it's hard to validate rollout.

Maya Patel (author): added stream_transient_failures and stream_terminal_failures metrics in runtime/streaming/error_classifier.py, pushed new commit 4.

Jordan Li: Request to ensure HTTP-date parsing edge cases are robust and timezone-agnostic. Also asked for an integration test that sends Retry-After as an HTTP-date more than 60s in the future.

Maya Patel: added parsing and capped behavior; included e2e test that covers HTTP-date > 60s and verifies cap at 120s.

Samara Ruiz: Noted potential security surface: allowing stream-scoped idempotency might cause replay of side-effecting tool calls. Requested operator warnings in docs and a KMS-backed enforcement check for enterprise installs.

Maya Patel: documented the warning and added an operator config flag "enforce_stream_idempotency_safety" for Private installs.
ci_checks: CI summary: initial run failed (flake8 and unit test failure in test_error_classification expecting old taxonomy). Fixes applied in commit 3. Re-run: all checks passed including unit tests (pytest), mypy, flake8, integration e2e (canary-sim) with simulated autoscaler pressure. Coverage: +0.8%.
merge_details: Merged by Alex Kim via squash merge. Commit message consolidated: 'stream: backpressure/retry contract and idempotency scoping for OpenAI-compat adapter — clarifies Retry-After handling and adds resumable stream semantics (ENG-1927, SUP-881)'.
release_notes: Operators: new compat.feature 'stream_retries' behind a feature flag. Default idempotency behavior unchanged. New headers: X-RW-Idempotency-Scope and normalized retry_after in OpenAI-compatible error objects. SDKs should adopt resumable-stream pattern to enable automatic stream resume on transient failures. See docs/compat/streaming-retry.md for details and rollout guidance.
